1.text: Nuko ari ahantu hamwe asenga, arangije umwe mu bigishwa be aramubwira ati “Databuja, twigishe gusenga nk'uko Yohana yigishije abigishwa be.”

2.text: Arababwira ati “Nimusenga mujye muvuga muti‘Data wa twese,Izina ryawe ryubahwe,Ubwami bwawe buze.

3.text: Uko bukeye ujye uduha ibyokurya byacu by'uwo munsi.

4.text: Utubabarire ibyaha byacu,Kuko natwe duharira abarimo imyenda yacu bose,Kandi ntuduhāne mu bitwoshya.’

5.text: Arababwira ati “Ni nde muri mwe ufite incuti, wayisanga mu gicuku akayibwira ati ‘Ncuti yanjye, nzimānira imitsima itatu

6.text: kuko incuti yanjye impingutseho ivuye mu rugendo, none nkaba ntafite icyo nyizimānira’,

7.text: uwo mu nzu akamusubiza ati ‘Windushya namaze kugarira, ndaryamye n'abana banjye na bo ni uko, sinshoboye kubyuka ngo nyiguhe.’

8.text: Ndababwira yuko nubwo atabyukijwe no kuyimuhera ko ari incuti ye, ariko kuko amutitirije biramubyutsa amuhe ibyo ashaka byose.

9.text: “Nanjye ndababwira nti ‘Musabe muzahabwa, mushake muzabona, mukomange ku rugi muzakingurirwa,

10.text: kuko umuntu wese usaba ahabwa, ushatse abona, n'ukomanga agakingurirwa.’

11.text: Mbese ni nde muri mwe ufite umwana, yamusaba umutsima akamuha ibuye? Cyangwa ifi akamuha inzoka?

13.text: None se ko muzi guha abana banyu ibyiza kandi muri babi, So wo mu ijuru ntazarushaho rwose guha Umwuka Wera abamumusabye?”

14.text: Yesu yirukanye dayimoni utera uburagi mu muntu, dayimoni amaze kuva mu kiragi kiravuga, abantu baratangara.

15.text: Ariko bamwe muri bo baravuga bati “Ni Belizebuli umutware w'abadayimoni umuha kwirukana abadayimoni.”

16.text: Abandi bamushakaho ikimenyetso kiva mu ijuru, bamugerageza.

17.text: Ariko amenya ibyo bibwira arababwira ati “Ubwami bwose iyo bwigabanije ubwabwo burarimbuka, n'inzu ikagwira indi.

18.text: Na Satani niba yigabanije ubwe ubwami bwe bwakomeza bute, ko muvuga yuko ari Belizebuli umpa kwirukana abadayimoni?

19.text: Ariko jyewe niba Belizebuli ari we umpa kwirukana abadayimoni, abana banyu ni nde ubaha kubirukana? Ni cyo gituma abo ari bo babacira urubanza.

20.text: Ariko urutoki rw'Imana niba ari rwo rumpa kwirukana abadayimoni, noneho ubwami bw'Imana bubaguye gitumo.

21.text: “Umunyamaboko ufite intwaro iyo arinze urugo rwe, ibintu bye biba amahoro.

22.text: Ariko umurusha amaboko iyo amuteye akamunesha, izo ntwaro ze zose yari yizigiye arazimwambura, n'ibyo amunyaze akabigaba.

23.text: “Uwo tutabana ni umwanzi wanjye, kandi uwo tudateraniriza hamwe arasandaza.

24.text: “Dayimoni iyo avuye mu muntu, azerera ahadafite amazi ashaka uburuhukiro, akabubura akavuga ati ‘Reka nisubirire mu nzu yanjye navuyemo.’

26.text: akagenda akazana abandi badayimoni barindwi bamurusha kuba babi, bakinjira bakayibamo. Nuko ibyo hanyuma by'uwo muntu bikarusha ibya mbere kuba bibi.”

27.text: Akivuga ibyo, umugore wari muri iryo teraniro ashyira ejuru aramubwira ati “Hahirwa inda yakubyaye n'amabere yakonkeje.”

28.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “Ahubwo hahirwa abumva ijambo ry'Imana bakaryitondera.”

29.text: Abantu benshi bateraniye aho atangira kubabwira ati “Ab'iki gihe ni abantu babi, bashaka ikimenyetso nyamara nta kimenyetso bazahabwa keretse icya Yona.

30.text: Nk'uko Yona yabereye ab'i Nineve ikimenyetso, ni ko Umwana w'umuntu azakibera ab'iki gihe.

31.text: Umugabekazi w'igihugu cy'ikusi, azahagurukana n'ab'iki gihe ku munsi w'amateka abatsindishe, kuko yavanywe ku mpera y'isi no kumva ubwenge bwa Salomo, kandi dore uruta Salomo ari hano.

32.text: Kandi ab'i Nineve bazahagurukana n'ab'iki gihe ku munsi w'amateka babatsindishe, kuko bihannye ubwo bumvaga kwigisha kwa Yona, kandi dore uruta Yona ari hano.

33.text: “Nta wukongeza itabaza ngo arishyire mu mwobo cyangwa munsi y'intonga, ahubwo arishyira ku gitereko cyaryo ngo abinjira babone umucyo.

34.text: Itabaza ry'umubiri ni ijisho. Nuko rero ijisho ryawe iyo rirebye neza, n'umubiri wawe wose ugira umucyo. Ariko iyo ribaye ribi, umubiri wawe wose ugira umwijima.

35.text: Witonde rero umucyo ukurimo utaba umwijima.

36.text: Niba umubiri wawe wose usābwa n'umucyo, ari nta mwanya n'umwe ufite umwijima, umubiri wose uzaba ufite umucyo nk'uko itabaza rikumurikishiriza umucyo waryo.”

37.text: Akivuga ibyo Umufarisayo aramurarika ngo aze iwe basangire, arinjira, aricara arafungura.

38.text: Umufarisayo abibonye atyo, aratangara kuko atabanje kujabika intoki mu mazi ngo abone kurya.

39.text: Umwami Yesu aramubwira ati “Mwebwe Abafarisayo mwoza inyuma y'igikombe n'imbehe, ariko mu nda yanyu huzuyemo ubwambuzi n'ububi.

40.text: Mwa bapfu mwe, iyaremye inyuma si yo yaremye no mu nda?

41.text: Ahubwo ibiri imbere abe ari byo mutangana ubuntu, ni bwo byose bizabatunganira.

42.text: “Ariko muzabona ishyano Bafarisayo, kuko mutanga kimwe mu icumi cy'isogi na nyiragasogereza n'imboga zose, mukirengagiza gukiranuka no gukunda Imana! Ibyo mwari mukwiriye kubikora na byo, na bya bindi ntimubireke.

43.text: “Muzabona ishyano Bafarisayo, kuko mukunda intebe z'icyubahiro mu masinagogi, no kuramukirizwa mu maguriro!

44.text: Muzabona ishyano kuko mumeze nk'ibituro bitagaragara, abantu bakabigendaho batabizi!”

45.text: Umwe mu bigishamategeko aramusubiza ati “Mwigisha, ubwo uvuze utyo natwe uradututse.”

46.text: Aramubwira ati “Namwe abigishamategeko muzabona ishyano, kuko mwikoreza abantu imitwaro idaterurwa, namwe ubwanyu ntimuyikozeho n'urutoki!

47.text: Muzabona ishyano kuko mwubaka ibituro by'abahanuzi, ba sogokuruza banyu ari bo babīshe!

48.text: Uko ni ko mwihamije ko mushima ibyo ba sogokuruza banyu bakoze, kuko ari bo babīshe namwe mukabubakira ibituro.

49.text: Ni cyo cyatumye Imana ivugisha ubwenge bwayo iti ‘Nzabatumaho abahanuzi n'intumwa bamwe muri bo bazabica, abandi bazabarenganya’,

50.text: kugira ngo amaraso y'abahanuzi bose yavuye uhereye ku kuremwa kw'isi abazwe ab'iki gihe,

51.text: uhereye ku maraso ya Abeli ukageza ku maraso ya Zakariya wiciwe hagati y'igicaniro n'urusengero. Ni koko ndababwira yuko azabazwa ab'iki gihe.

52.text: “Muzabona ishyano abigishamategeko, kuko mwatwaye urufunguzo rw'ubwenge ubwanyu ntimwinjira, n'abashakaga kwinjira mwarababujije!”

53.text: Nuko asohotse, abanditsi n'Abafarisayo batangira kumuhataniraho cyane no kumwiyenzaho ngo bamuvugishe byinshi,

54.text: bashaka kumutega kugira ngo bamufateho ijambo rizamushinja.
